Level 4  
 
General comprehension  
 The main theme or ideas of fairly complex texts are identified.  
 Views and attitudes are ide ntified, and the development of an argument followed.  
Specific comprehension  
 Obvious inferences are made in fairly complex texts.  More sophisticated inferences are made 
if the text is simple and the topic is familiar.  
 The meaning of words and phrase s is identified when a context is given by one or more 
 sentences or a paragraph in fairly complex texts.  
Awareness of style  
 Tone and mood are interpreted in fairly complex texts.
